PAGE TITLE: AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

KEY FACTS:
- The text discusses the Human Landing System (HLS) and ESDMD's recognition of challenges identified by the OIG.
- The document refers to SpaceX and Blue Origin regarding HLS development, Starship test flights, and the Blue Moon lander.
- Critical design review for Artemis III's initial capability is set for summer 2025.
- SpaceX plans to undertake a long-duration flight test and a propellant transfer flight test in 2025.
- Blue Origin's first test flight of the New Glenn rocket is scheduled for no earlier than November 2024.
